source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The test adjustment removes an assertion that a br must precede the attachment root. Accepted source types into the composer and checks the typed text immediately above root.previousSibling. Keep that observable insertion contract when editor DOM normalization changes. Other reply-below tests may still need br nodes; this one change is not a ban on structural assertions. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Assert the Filelink caret result without requiring an obsolete br sibling
